text:
Maya Chen: Afternoon team — starting a short kickoff thread for the new account (Nimbus Phase 1). Goal: align stakeholders, lay out success criteria, and lock a 30d timeline. Needs: owners for enablement, infra preflight, SSO, data onboarding. Main risk: AE flagged renewal attention at ~90d (contract not inked). @Jared can you confirm technical contacts? @Priya can you lead enablement sessions?

Eli Turner: Jared is OOO this morning — I can cover. Tech contacts are Dan R. (infra) and Noor K. (API/integrations). I'll send an infra preflight invite for Thu 10am PT.

Jared Kim: Back now — Dan and Noor are good. Dan asked that we share the runbook draft before the preflight so he can review infra requirements.

Priya Rao: Happy to own enablement. Proposed cadence: Day 3 — fundamentals (auth, basic calls), Day 7 — integration deep-dive (hooks, retries, obs), Day 14 — QA + troubleshooting workshop. I need a sample prompt set and a demo dataset (~500 rows) to build exercises. I'll record sessions and post slides.

Sophie Alvarez: Draft success criteria for tracking: 1) API integration: end-to-end test calls passing 2) Latency: p50 <200ms for baseline routes 3) Cost forecast within +5% of initial estimate for first 30d 4) Enablement feedback: NPS >=4 and at least 3 engaged engineers 5) Data onboarding: sample dataset validated and schema locked. I'll add these to the success doc.

Maya Chen: Perfect. I'll create the shared success doc and a simple timeline. Quick asks: who'll track renewal risk/CRM flags? AE listed 'contract-not-signed-45d' in the deal notes which bumps priority.

Jared Kim: I can own the renewal tracker and escalate if we see adoption slippage. Suggest a 15m weekly health sync (Wed 9am PT) to keep things visible. Also want to make sure we have a fallback model variant plan in case perf regresses — add that to runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder — create calendar invites using template "cs - kickoff v2" and include Zoom link + success doc link once available.

Priya Rao: I'll also create a short feedback form (Google Form) to capture enablement ratings and open issues after each session. Will share link in #customer-success and with the team at end of week.

Maya Chen: Action items recap: Maya -> create success doc + post link; Eli -> send infra preflight invite (Thu 10am PT); Priya -> prep enablement plan, slides, recording, feedback form; Jared -> runbook + renewal tracker + own weekly health sync; Sophie -> add success criteria to doc. Reconvene Fri for 15m status check. :thumbsup:

Eli Turner: Sending infra invite now — included Dan & Noor. Adding a short checklist: SSO test account, sample payload schema, perf baseline script (curl example below).

Eli Turner: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hello"}'
```

Maya Chen: Thanks — linking the doc when ready. If anything urgent pops up, ping me directly.

ops-bot: Note: please tag any action items with "owner: <name>" inside the success doc to keep status automatable.
